sunlit_cobblemon_tips.tip.workstation_ev: The IVs and EVs of a Pokémon affect its performance in a workstation.
sunlit_cobblemon_tips.tip.pokemon_friend: Bake Pofflets to increase your Pokémon's friendship!
Battle with you Pokémon to increase its friendship.
Letting a Pokémon walk around outside of its ball slowly increases its friendship.
sunlit_cobblemon_tips.tip.sun_raid_statu: Sun Raid Statues draw from the current spawn pool of a location.
Sun Raid Statues have a higher chance of spawning Shiny Pokémon.
sunlit_cobblemon_tips.tip.mystica_cookie: Mystica Cookies can be used to look for specific Pokémon in a biome's pool.
sunlit_cobblemon_tips.tip.quest_catching: Evolving a Pokémon also counts as catch in the trainer rank quests.
sunlit_cobblemon_tips.tip.quest_hatching: Hatching a Pokémon also counts as catch in the trainer rank quests.
sunlit_cobblemon_tips.tip.breeding_shiny: Breeding a Pokémon with a ditto from another trainer increases its chance of laying a shiny egg.
sunlit_cobblemon_tips.tip.surprise_crops: Certain types of Pokémon will pop out from harvesting certain types of crops.
sunlit_cobblemon_tips.tip.surprise_ore: Certain types of Pokémon will pop out from mining certain ore.
sunlit_cobblemon_tips.tip.magikarp_taiya: Nobody has figured out how Magikarp makes its famous Taiyaki.
sunlit_cobblemon_tips.tip.trainer_podium: The trainers that come to your gym are based on your team's average level.
Having an overleveled Pokémon compared to your team makes gym trainers harder.
sunlit_cobblemon_tips.tip.ranching_drops: Ranching Stations can be used to farm a Pokémon's drops using Magic Shears or Fairy Types.
